mathematics: All sixteen table entries match the source s1…s4 ordering exactly.
The group is constructed as Z2 direct-sum Z2, with s1 the identity and each element its own inverse.

The reusable Style checks closure, all associative triples, the unique identity and all two-sided inverses from the complete recorded product facts. It rejects false associativity and incorrectly asserted inverses.
